_about: A9 §12 stamp vector (Clouds' ruling on #67, Winds' change: the stampless id is the record core's stamplessId, record.ts). Recompute: stampless_id = stamplessId(record) = base64url SHA-256(DOMAIN + canonical JSON of the record's kind fields in kind order, stamp omitted); digest = SHA-256(UTF-8(stampless_id) + UTF-8(stamp)); leading_zero_bits(digest) >= bits.
